$Comment: A Week of Lessons: the Mastery Trainer's weekly, finish five lessons from the trainer's board
(Mmo_Mastery_Lessons) and collect a week's bonus standing.
Repeat.Reset with Period Weekly is a CALENDAR week: the allowance turns over at Monday midnight UTC
(author Weekday or AtMinutes on the Reset block to move it), so five lessons on any days of the week
count, and a missed day or two still leaves room to finish.
It opens once A Word with the Trainer or What You Already Paid is collected (the AnyOf in Requires,
the same two quests that open the board) and accepts itself then and after every reset (AutoAccept),
pinned to the tracker (AutoTrack), so the player sees what the lessons build toward without asking.
Listing.RequirePrerequisites keeps it out of the Objective Book until one of the two is collected;
a player whose log was full when it tried to arm finds it there to
take by hand. The feature gate keeps it out of the log on a server with mastery switched off.
The step is COMPLETE_BOUNTY on the board's id, which the plugin fires each time a contract from that
board is collected; with no Qualifier, any band counts. TextKey words it as the trainer's lessons.
TurnInAt names the trainer, so the standing waits in the Claim bucket until the player collects it
